1.note: Measures whether changed files and actual changed hunk lines intersect recorded realization/proof ranges on their own comparison sides. A delete-only hunk cannot borrow a C span; an insertion-only hunk cannot borrow a B span. Non-text linkage requires whole-file coverage rather than any symbol at that path. Resolved recorded ranges are linkage observations, not an authored acceptance or invariant-effect judgment.

2.note:
A path’s computed placements and intersections are shared, while the worklist receives the same linked boolean.
